<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Super Simple WASM Raycaster</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: #111;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
      }
      canvas {
        image-rendering: pixelated;
        border: 2px solid #444;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = -1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();
        const matPtr = wasm.get_material_ptr();
        const tuPtr = wasm.get_tex_u_ptr();
        const tvPtr = wasm.get_tex_v_ptr();

        // load textures
        async function loadTexture(src) {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
          await img.decode();
          const c = document.createElement('canvas');
          c.width = img.width;
          c.height = img.height;
          const cx = c.getContext('2d');
          cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
          return cx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        }

        const [wallTex, floorTex] = await Promise.all([
          loadTexture('../assets/wall.png'),
          loadTexture('../assets/floor.png'),
        ]);

        let fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
        let materials = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, matPtr, w * h);
        let texU = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tuPtr, w * h);
        let texV = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tvPtr, w * h);
        let img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);

        function ensureViews() {
          // memory.buffer might grow; if so recreate views
          if (fb.buffer !== memory.buffer) {
            fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
            materials = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, matPtr, w * h);
            texU = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tuPtr, w * h);
            texV = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tvPtr, w * h);
            img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);
          }
        }

        function sampleTexIntoFB() {
          const tw = wallTex.width;
          const th = wallTex.height;
          const fw = floorTex.width;
          const fh = floorTex.height;
          const wallData = wallTex.data;
          const floorData = floorTex.data;

          for (let i = 0, px = 0; i < w * h; i++, px += 4) {
            const m = materials[i];
            if (m === 2) {
              const u = texU[i] / 255;
              const v = texV[i] / 255;
              const tx = Math.floor(u * (tw - 1));
              const ty = Math.floor(v * (th - 1));
              const ti = (ty * tw + tx) * 4;
              fb[px] = wallData[ti];
              fb[px + 1] = wallData[ti + 1];
              fb[px + 2] = wallData[ti + 2];
              // keep alpha 255
            } else if (m === 1) {
              const u = texU[i] / 255;
              const v = texV[i] / 255;
              const tx = Math.floor(u * (fw - 1));
              const ty = Math.floor(v * (fh - 1));
              const ti = (ty * fw + tx) * 4;
              fb[px] = floorData[ti];
              fb[px + 1] = floorData[ti + 1];
              fb[px + 2] = floorData[ti + 2];
            }
          }
        }

        function frame() {
          ensureViews();
          wasm.step(forward, turn, strafe, jump);
          sampleTexIntoFB();
          ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        frame();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Super Simple WASM Raycaster</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: #111;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
      }
      canvas {
        image-rendering: pixelated;
        border: 2px solid #444;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = -1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();
        const matPtr = wasm.get_material_ptr();
        const tuPtr = wasm.get_tex_u_ptr();
        const tvPtr = wasm.get_tex_v_ptr();

        // load textures
        async function loadTexture(src) {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
          await img.decode();
          const c = document.createElement("canvas");
          c.width = img.width;
          c.height = img.height;
          const cx = c.getContext("2d");
          cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
          return cx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        }

        const [wallTex, floorTex] = await Promise.all([
          loadTexture("../assets/wall.png"),
          loadTexture("../assets/floor.png"),
        ]);

        let fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
        let materials = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, matPtr, w * h);
        let texU = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tuPtr, w * h);
        let texV = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tvPtr, w * h);
        let img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);

        function ensureViews() {
          // memory.buffer might grow; if so recreate views
          if (fb.buffer !== memory.buffer) {
            fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
            materials = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, matPtr, w * h);
            texU = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tuPtr, w * h);
            texV = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, tvPtr, w * h);
            img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);
          }
        }

        function sampleTexIntoFB() {
          const tw = wallTex.width;
          const th = wallTex.height;
          const fw = floorTex.width;
          const fh = floorTex.height;
          const wallData = wallTex.data;
          const floorData = floorTex.data;

          for (let i = 0, px = 0; i < w * h; i++, px += 4) {
            const m = materials[i];
            if (m === 2) {
              const u = texU[i] / 255;
              const v = texV[i] / 255;
              const tx = Math.floor(u * (tw - 1));
              const ty = Math.floor(v * (th - 1));
              const ti = (ty * tw + tx) * 4;
              fb[px] = wallData[ti];
              fb[px + 1] = wallData[ti + 1];
              fb[px + 2] = wallData[ti + 2];
              // keep alpha 255
            } else if (m === 1) {
              const u = texU[i] / 255;
              const v = texV[i] / 255;
              const tx = Math.floor(u * (fw - 1));
              const ty = Math.floor(v * (fh - 1));
              const ti = (ty * fw + tx) * 4;
              fb[px] = floorData[ti];
              fb[px + 1] = floorData[ti + 1];
              fb[px + 2] = floorData[ti + 2];
            }
          }
        }

        function frame() {
          // Call step first (wasm may grow memory), then refresh views.
          wasm.step(forward, turn, strafe, jump);
          ensureViews();
          sampleTexIntoFB();
          ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        frame();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Super Simple WASM Raycaster</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: #111;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
      }
      canvas {
        image-rendering: pixelated;
        border: 2px solid #444;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = -1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();
        const matPtr = wasm.get_material_ptr();
        const tuPtr = wasm.get_tex_u_ptr();
        const tvPtr = wasm.get_tex_v_ptr();

        // load textures
        async function loadTexture(src) {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
          await img.decode();
          const c = document.createElement("canvas");
          c.width = img.width;
          c.height = img.height;
          const cx = c.getContext("2d");
          cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
          return cx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        }

        const [wallTex, floorTex] = await Promise.all([
          loadTexture("../assets/wall.png"),
          loadTexture("../assets/floor.png"),
        ]);

        let fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
        let materials = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, matPtr, w * h);
        // tex coords are now 16-bit (0..65535)
        let texU = new Uint16Array(memory.buffer, tuPtr, w * h);
        let texV = new Uint16Array(memory.buffer, tvPtr, w * h);
        let img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);

        function ensureViews() {
          // memory.buffer might grow; if so recreate views
          if (fb.buffer !== memory.buffer) {
            fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
            materials = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer, matPtr, w * h);
            texU = new Uint16Array(memory.buffer, tuPtr, w * h);
            texV = new Uint16Array(memory.buffer, tvPtr, w * h);
            img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);
          }
        }

        function sampleTexIntoFB() {
          const tw = wallTex.width;
          const th = wallTex.height;
          const fw = floorTex.width;
          const fh = floorTex.height;
          const wallData = wallTex.data;
          const floorData = floorTex.data;

          for (let i = 0, px = 0; i < w * h; i++, px += 4) {
            const m = materials[i];
            if (m === 2) {
              const u = texU[i] / 65535;
              const v = texV[i] / 65535;
              const tx = Math.floor(u * (tw - 1));
              const ty = Math.floor(v * (th - 1));
              const ti = (ty * tw + tx) * 4;
              fb[px] = wallData[ti];
              fb[px + 1] = wallData[ti + 1];
              fb[px + 2] = wallData[ti + 2];
              // keep alpha 255
            } else if (m === 1) {
              const u = texU[i] / 65535;
              const v = texV[i] / 65535;
              const tx = Math.floor(u * (fw - 1));
              const ty = Math.floor(v * (fh - 1));
              const ti = (ty * fw + tx) * 4;
              fb[px] = floorData[ti];
              fb[px + 1] = floorData[ti + 1];
              fb[px + 2] = floorData[ti + 2];
            }
          }
        }

        function frame() {
          // Call step first (wasm may grow memory), then refresh views.
          wasm.step(forward, turn, strafe, jump);
          ensureViews();
          sampleTexIntoFB();
          ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        frame();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Super Simple WASM Raycaster</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: #111;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
      }
      canvas {
        image-rendering: pixelated;
        border: 2px solid #444;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = -1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();

        // load textures
        async function loadTexture(src) {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
          await img.decode();
          const c = document.createElement("canvas");
          c.width = img.width;
          c.height = img.height;
          const cx = c.getContext("2d");
          cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
          const imgData = cx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
          return { width: img.width, height: img.height, data: imgData.data };
        }

        const [wallTex, floorTex] = await Promise.all([
          loadTexture("../assets/wall.png"),
          loadTexture("../assets/floor.png"),
        ]);

        // Get pointers to texture buffers in WASM memory
        const wallTexPtr = wasm.get_wall_texture_ptr();
        const floorTexPtr = wasm.get_floor_texture_ptr();

        // Helper to safely create views into WASM memory
        function createWasmBuffer(ptr, width, height, name) {
          const bytes = width * height * 4;
          if (typeof ptr !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(ptr)) {
            throw new Error(`${name} ptr is not a number: ${ptr}`);
          }
          if (!Number.isInteger(bytes) || bytes <= 0) {
            throw new Error(`${name} invalid size: ${width}x${height}`);
          }
          const buf = memory.buffer;
          if (ptr < 0 || ptr > buf.byteLength) {
            throw new Error(`${name} ptr out of range: ${ptr} / ${buf.byteLength}`);
          }

  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Super Simple WASM Raycaster</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: #111;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;

  <body>
    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = -1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();

        // load textures
        async function loadTexture(src) {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
          await img.decode();
          const c = document.createElement("canvas");
          c.width = img.width;
          c.height = img.height;
          const cx = c.getContext("2d");
          cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
          const imgData = cx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
          return { width: img.width, height: img.height, data: imgData.data };
        }

        const [wallTex, floorTex] = await Promise.all([
          loadTexture("../assets/wall.png"),
          loadTexture("../assets/floor.png"),
        ]);

        // Get pointers to texture buffers in WASM memory
        const wallTexPtr = wasm.get_wall_texture_ptr();
        const floorTexPtr = wasm.get_floor_texture_ptr();

        // Helper to safely create views into WASM memory
        function createWasmBuffer(ptr, width, height, name) {
          const bytes = width * height * 4;
          if (typeof ptr !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(ptr)) {
            throw new Error(`${name} ptr is not a number: ${ptr}`);
          }
          if (!Number.isInteger(bytes) || bytes <= 0) {
            throw new Error(`${name} invalid size: ${width}x${height}`);
          }
          const buf = memory.buffer;
          if (ptr < 0 || ptr > buf.byteLength) {
            throw new Error(`${name} ptr out of range: ${ptr} / ${buf.byteLength}`);
          }
          const available = buf.byteLength - ptr;
          if (bytes > available) {
            console.warn(`${name} requested ${bytes} bytes but only ${available} available; truncating`);
          }
          const len = Math.min(bytes, available);
          return new Uint8Array(buf, ptr, len);
        }

        // Copy texture data directly into WASM linear memory (with sanity checks)
        const wallMemory = createWasmBuffer(wallTexPtr, wallTex.width, wallTex.height, "wall");
        const wallRequired = wallTex.width * wallTex.height * 4;
        console.log("wall tex", wallTex.width, "x", wallTex.height, "required bytes", wallRequired, "wasm available", wallMemory.length);
        if (wallMemory.length < wallRequired) {
          console.error("Not enough WASM memory for wall texture; try increasing WASM memory or shrinking texture.");
        }
        // Create a Uint8Array view that respects the ImageData view offset and length
        const wallSrc = new Uint8Array(wallTex.data.buffer, wallTex.data.byteOffset || 0, wallTex.data.byteLength || wallTex.data.length);
        // Copy only up to the available length in WASM memory
        wallMemory.set(wallSrc.subarray(0, Math.min(wallSrc.length, wallMemory.length)));
        wasm.set_wall_texture_size(wallTex.width, wallTex.height);

        const floorMemory = createWasmBuffer(floorTexPtr, floorTex.width, floorTex.height, "floor");
        const floorRequired = floorTex.width * floorTex.height * 4;
        console.log("floor tex", floorTex.width, "x", floorTex.height, "required bytes", floorRequired, "wasm available", floorMemory.length);
        if (floorMemory.length < floorRequired) {
          console.error("Not enough WASM memory for floor texture; try increasing WASM memory or shrinking texture.");
        }
        const floorSrc = new Uint8Array(floorTex.data.buffer, floorTex.data.byteOffset || 0, floorTex.data.byteLength || floorTex.data.length);
        floorMemory.set(floorSrc.subarray(0, Math.min(floorSrc.length, floorMemory.length)));
        wasm.set_floor_texture_size(floorTex.width, floorTex.height);

        let fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
        let img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);

        function ensureViews() {
          // memory.buffer might grow; if so recreate views
          if (fb.buffer !== memory.buffer) {
            fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
            img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);
          }
        }

        function frame() {
          // Call step first (wasm may grow memory), then refresh views.
          wasm.step(forward, turn, strafe, jump);
          ensureViews();
          ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        frame();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Super Simple WASM Raycaster</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: #111;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
      }
      canvas {
        image-rendering: pixelated;
        border: 2px solid #444;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = -1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();

        // load textures
        async function loadTexture(src) {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = src;
          await img.decode();
          const c = document.createElement("canvas");
          c.width = img.width;
          c.height = img.height;
          const cx = c.getContext("2d");
          cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
          const imgData = cx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
          return { width: img.width, height: img.height, data: imgData.data };
        }

        const [wallTex, floorTex] = await Promise.all([
          loadTexture("../assets/wall.png"),
          loadTexture("../assets/floor.png"),
        ]);

        // Allocate texture buffers in WASM memory for the exact sizes we need
        const wallTexPtr = wasm.alloc_wall_texture(wallTex.width, wallTex.height);
        const floorTexPtr = wasm.alloc_floor_texture(floorTex.width, floorTex.height);

        // Helper to safely create views into WASM memory
        function createWasmBuffer(ptr, width, height, name) {
          const bytes = width * height * 4;
          if (typeof ptr !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(ptr)) {
            throw new Error(`${name} ptr is not a number: ${ptr}`);
          }
          if (!Number.isInteger(bytes) || bytes <= 0) {
            throw new Error(`${name} invalid size: ${width}x${height}`);
          }
          const buf = memory.buffer;
          if (ptr < 0 || ptr > buf.byteLength) {
            throw new Error(`${name} ptr out of range: ${ptr} / ${buf.byteLength}`);
          }
          const available = buf.byteLength - ptr;
          if (bytes > available) {
            console.warn(`${name} requested ${bytes} bytes but only ${available} available; truncating`);
          }
          const len = Math.min(bytes, available);
          return new Uint8Array(buf, ptr, len);
        }

        // Copy texture data directly into WASM linear memory (with sanity checks)
        const wallMemory = createWasmBuffer(wallTexPtr, wallTex.width, wallTex.height, "wall");
        const wallRequired = wallTex.width * wallTex.height * 4;
        console.log("wall tex", wallTex.width, "x", wallTex.height, "required bytes", wallRequired, "wasm available", wallMemory.length);
        if (wallMemory.length < wallRequired) {
          console.error("Not enough WASM memory for wall texture; try increasing WASM memory or shrinking texture.");
        }
        // Create a Uint8Array view that respects the ImageData view offset and length
        const wallSrc = new Uint8Array(wallTex.data.buffer, wallTex.data.byteOffset || 0, wallTex.data.byteLength || wallTex.data.length);
        // Copy only up to the available length in WASM memory
        wallMemory.set(wallSrc.subarray(0, Math.min(wallSrc.length, wallMemory.length)));
        wasm.set_wall_texture_size(wallTex.width, wallTex.height);

        const floorMemory = createWasmBuffer(floorTexPtr, floorTex.width, floorTex.height, "floor");
        const floorRequired = floorTex.width * floorTex.height * 4;
        console.log("floor tex", floorTex.width, "x", floorTex.height, "required bytes", floorRequired, "wasm available", floorMemory.length);
        if (floorMemory.length < floorRequired) {
          console.error("Not enough WASM memory for floor texture; try increasing WASM memory or shrinking texture.");
        }
        const floorSrc = new Uint8Array(floorTex.data.buffer, floorTex.data.byteOffset || 0, floorTex.data.byteLength || floorTex.data.length);
        floorMemory.set(floorSrc.subarray(0, Math.min(floorSrc.length, floorMemory.length)));
        wasm.set_floor_texture_size(floorTex.width, floorTex.height);

        let fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
        let img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);

        function ensureViews() {
          // memory.buffer might grow; if so recreate views
          if (fb.buffer !== memory.buffer) {
            fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
            img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);
          }
        }

        function frame() {
          // Call step first (wasm may grow memory), then refresh views.
          wasm.step(forward, turn, strafe, jump);
          ensureViews();
          ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        frame();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

## Summary

I've fixed both issues:

### 1. **Black Screenshots Issue** (was actually uniform gray)
The problem was that Puppeteer's `screenshot()` with `clip` parameter uses CSS pixels, not canvas pixels. Since the canvas was scaled 3x with CSS (960x600px display size vs 320x200px actual canvas), the screenshots were capturing a scaled/resampled version.

**Solution**: Changed all test files to use `canvas.toDataURL()` instead, which captures the actual canvas pixel data directly. Now screenshots are:
- Correct dimensions: 320x200 pixels
- Full color range: ~10,200 unique colors
- Realistic file sizes: 39KB-138KB vs previous 560B

### 2. **Texture Perspective Deformation**
The texture UV flipping logic was using `ray_dir_x` and `ray_dir_y` which are continuous values, when it should use `step_x` and `step_y` which indicate which wall face was hit.

**Solution**: Updated [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs#L199-L213) to flip `tex_u` based on:
- For vertical walls (side==0): flip if `step_x > 0` (east face)
- For horizontal walls (side==1): flip if `step_y < 0` (north face)

This ensures textures are oriented consistently relative to the wall face, preventing the frontal projection artifact when approaching walls diagonally.

All three tests now generate proper screenshots with correctly rendered wall textures and floor tiles.
